description: Locations and chronology for the 36 rows of the finds-abroad census (experiments/2026-10-06-evidence-census/sites-deep/d-finds-abroad/site-rows.json). Counts are copied from the census without reconciliation. Dates are BCE; start_bce >= end_bce; start_bce null marks a terminus ante quem. basis: 'object context' = date of the find layer or context of a counted object; 'site period' = phase range of the site; 'conventional' = typological, museum or regional convention not tied to the find layer. confidence: 'context-dated' if any entry has object-context basis.

sites.finds_summary: Gadd catalogued 16 Indus-style seals from Ur, inscribed and uninscribed (gadd1932). Laursen selects six round Gulf-type seals with Indus or uncertain signs, Gadd nos. 2-5 and 15-16 (laursen2010); Gadd also lists a stamp seal with a cuneiform legend (no. 1) and a cylinder with disputed Indus-like signs (no. 7).
